nodes.title: Route tool suggestion requests to the API server instead of the frontend origin
nodes.summary: The POST to /api/tool-suggestions returns 404 because src/lib/tools/toolSuggestionsClient.ts passes the relative path /api/tool-suggestions straight to fetch(). In the deployed app that resolves to pened-creator.fly.dev, the frontend host, which has no such route, so the request never reaches pened-server. Export a small apiUrl(path) helper from src/lib/curriculum/shared/apiClient.ts that reuses the existing validated VITE_API_URL base URL (buildUrl). Make the real adapter call fetch(apiUrl(TOOL_SUGGESTIONS_PATH)), keeping credentials: "include". Update toolSuggestionsClient.test.ts, which currently asserts the relative URL, to expect the full API URL. Then redeploy the frontend and confirm a suggestion submits with a 201 from the deployed app. Also confirm CORS_ORIGIN on pened-server includes https://pened-creator.fly.dev.

nodes.title: Prevent API calls that bypass the shared API client
nodes.summary: The suggestions client reached production with a relative URL because it calls fetch() directly instead of going through apiClient.ts, and the mock adapter and the unit test hid the problem. Add a guard so this cannot recur: either a check in scripts/ (run in verify.yml alongside check-folder-boundaries.js) or an ESLint rule that fails on any fetch() to a path starting with /api/ outside apiClient.ts and authClient.ts. Add a test that the real suggestions adapter builds its URL from VITE_API_URL. Document in the tools README that all API calls must use the shared client so the base URL, credentials and error handling stay in one place.
